answers.reason: Q7.4 says a supplement can be submitted before implementation, which is optional, and the statement captures that option fully. PAT applies to all plant types.
Q7.6 says manufacturers should evaluate and discuss the option with the Agency, so it is recommended. The statement matches it without adding or omitting anything.

Q13.6 falls under the topical antiseptic considerations ('Consider all possible sources'), so it is recommended. The statement keeps the topical antiseptic context and the open-bin risk, and LIQ/SEMI fit the scope.
Q14.7 is a 'should' general principle that applies to all manufacturers. The statement reproduces it fully.

The statement keeps the lead-in condition (leptospiral contamination possible or occurred) and the 'should' recommendation for microscopic examination in routine cell culture control. Cell culture applies to API and INJ.
In Q16.1 FDA 'encourages' innovative approaches to ensuring adequacy of mixing, which is recommended. Powder blends apply to OSD.
The quoted USP text in Q19.1 is a 'should not' recommendation, and the statement reproduces it fully. The nonsterile and multidose presterilization scope fits OSD/LIQ/SEMI/INJ.
Q22.1 says both terminally sterilized and aseptically processed batches are required to meet the sterility test before release, which is mandatory. Sterile products map to INJ.
